title: Intrvue.ai Medicine — station
description: One practice unit. A station is a point in six-dimensional space (domain x format x context x actor x difficulty x scoring), not a question with metadata attached. Vocabularies: data/taxonomies.json. Domain ontology: data/ontology.json.

station_id.description: Immutable. Never reused, even after retirement.

version.description: Semver. Minor = wording; major = anything that changes what is assessed, which invalidates historical score comparability.

title.description: Internal name. Never shown to the user before the station runs — a title can leak the answer.

primary_topic.description: Exactly one leaf topic from ontology.json. Forces authoring discipline.

assessment_domains.description: Top-level domains. More than three means the station is unfocused.

engines.description: Derived from format + delivery; stored for query performance.

applicant_role.description: REQUIRED and must state what the candidate does NOT have access to or authority over. This field is the primary defence against stations that position an applicant as a clinician.

opening_prompt.description: Exact words shown or spoken to the candidate at t=0.

candidate_brief.description: Text shown during preparation time, if any. Absent for zero-prep stations (Aberdeen, Manchester).

stimulus.description: Supplied material for DI, AD, CA, SP and E8 pre-read stations.

supplied_in_advance.description: True only for Keele-style pre-read stations.

actor.description: Required when format is RP, IT, EX or GT.

roleplay_ref.description: Pointer to the full persona in roleplays.json. Personas are shared assets, not duplicated per station.

preparation_time_seconds.description: 0 for Aberdeen/Manchester/BSMS-style zero-prep. 60 for UCL. 120 for Leeds and Brunel. 300 for HYMS thinking time.

notes_permitted.description: False by default. Bristol, Sheffield and QMUL Malta explicitly ban notes; Bristol also bans AI tools.

adjustments_available.description: Extended time, rephrasing on request (Leeds permits this explicitly), transcript-first delivery. Accessibility is a product requirement, not an afterthought.

interactive_only.description: True if this dimension cannot be scored from a transcript. Suppressed and disclosed in asynchronous or text mode rather than scored silently.

scoring_dimensions.description: Weights must sum to 1.0. S1 and S2 are mandatory on every station (Imperial: 6 content / 4 communication; Aberdeen scores communication at every station regardless of domain).

point.description: A SUBSTANTIVE consideration, never a phrase. 'Names who they would escalate to' is valid; 'says the word escalate' is not.

necessity.description: required = absence caps the band; expected = absence costs marks; optional_strong = presence lifts, absence costs nothing.

evidence_cues.description: Transcript patterns indicating the point was made. Semantic, not literal string matching.

counts_only_if_applied.description: ANTI-BUZZWORD FLAG. When true, naming the concept scores zero; only application to this scenario scores. Set true for the four principles, the Mental Capacity Act, NHS values, duty of candour, the inverse care law, 'correlation is not causation'.

optional_strong_points.description: Discriminators that lift a strong answer. Never penalised by absence.

red_flags.description: Reported separately and never averaged away by a strong total (Plymouth scores a binary red-flag section alongside its numeric scale).

model_answer_principles.description: DELIBERATELY NOT model_answer. Principles a good answer embodies, never a script. City St George's publishes: 'Often there is no right or wrong answer.'

band_descriptors.description: Station-specific overrides. Defaults come from the dimension rubrics in scoring-rubrics.json.

priority.description: 1 = highest. Safety-critical corrections outrank depth probes.

max_followups.description: Hard cap. Real interviewers do not interrogate indefinitely.

interrupt_policy.description: Interrupting on a missing keyword is forbidden — see Output 7.

do_not_lead.description: Content the follow-up must never supply. If the station tests whether the candidate reaches safeguarding, the follow-up may not mention safeguarding.

hidden_information.description: Facts withheld until a disclosure condition is met. The model must NEVER volunteer these, including when the candidate is struggling.

band.description: DERIVED from the variable vector, not set by hand. 4_adversarial must be labelled in the UI as harder than a real station.

mode.description: 'universal' is the default and should be the majority. Per-school inclusion lists are a maintenance burden and are only justified where a school's published format demands it.

requires_application_questioning.description: TRUE for AC-format stations. These must NEVER be served to schools whose application_questioning is false — Imperial, Sheffield, Newcastle, BSMS, Plymouth, Bristol, Glasgow, Nottingham, UEA.

source_basis.description: Surfaced to the user. Provenance is a differentiator, not internal metadata.

confidence.description: Confidence that this station represents a real UK interview demand.

clinical_knowledge_boundary.description: CLINICAL is invalid for a live station. If a clinical element appears it must be bait, with declining as the scored behaviour — set clinical_bait true instead.

clinical_bait.description: True where the scenario invites clinical advice and declining is the top-band behaviour.

premed_appropriate.description: reward_only = credit if offered, never required, never penalised by absence. Set for the seven conditional ontology topics.

current_affairs_expiry.description: Inherited from the referenced CA topic. Past this date the station is WITHHELD, not flagged.

clinical_review.description: Required for every station touching safeguarding, capacity, confidentiality, end of life, or any clinical bait.

sensitivity_flags.description: Drives a content warning and an opt-out. A candidate should never be ambushed by a bereavement station.

wellbeing_rules.description: Station-level guards, e.g. 'never prompt for the candidate's own health', 'never require disclosure of a family member's condition'.

analytics.description: Written by the system, not the author. Used to retire bad stations.

discrimination_index.description: Correlation with overall performance. Low discrimination = the station is not distinguishing anyone and should be retired.

hidden_fact_leak_rate.description: Roleplay only. Proportion of sessions where a gated fact was revealed without its condition being met. Target < 0.02.

user_dispute_rate.description: Proportion of sessions where the user challenged the feedback. The single best early-warning signal for a wrong rubric.
